title: Predictive Allostatic Organization in Recurrent and Spiking Agents Under Partial Observability
abstract: arXiv:2608.11506v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Adaptive behavior under partial observability depends on internal organization that carries information beyond the current observation. Drawing on Barrett and Miller's account of categorization as predictive, compressive, functionally organized, and allostatically constrained, we test whether recurrent and spiking agents develop internal states with corresponding computational properties. Agents operate in an energy-constrained foraging task requiring resource acquisition, threat avoidance, contact-dependent consumption, and regulation of an internal energy variable. In a frozen benchmark, learned agents outperform random and heuristic baselines; the trace-augmented recurrent policy is strongest overall, while spiking variants show stress-specific differences. translated_title: 部分可观测条件下递归与脉冲智能体的预测性异稳态组织
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.11506v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：在部分可观测条件下，适应性行为依赖于携带超越当前观测信息的内部组织。借鉴Barrett和Miller关于分类作为预测性、压缩性、功能性组织且受异稳态约束的论述，我们测试了递归和脉冲智能体是否发展出具有相应计算特性的内部状态。智能体在一个能量受限的觅食任务中运行，该任务要求资源获取、威胁规避、接触依赖的消耗以及内部能量变量的调节。在冻结基准测试中，学习过的智能体优于随机和启发式基线；轨迹增强的递归策略整体最强，而脉冲变体表现出压力特异性差异。早期内部动态预测后期完全安全高效的成功率高于排列基线，达到最大ROC-AUC为0.802。降维PCA子空间保留了行为相关特征。
tldr: 该论文验证了在部分可观测条件下，递归和脉冲智能体通过发展预测性、压缩性和异稳态约束的内部状态来支持自适应行为，其中轨迹增强的递归策略表现最优，且早期内部动态能有效预测后期任务成功。
en_tdlr: This paper validates that recurrent and spiking agents develop predictive, compressive, and allostatically constrained internal states under partial observability, with trace-augmented recurrent policies performing best and early internal dynamics effectively predicting later task success.
